mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (task_id, user_id, title, region, summary, total_days, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{region}, #{summary}, #{totalDays}, NOW())

INSERT INTO plan_steps (plan_id, step_order, day_number, attraction_name, latitude, longitude, estimated_duration_min, traffic_time_from_prev, weather_note, llm_description, created_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{stepOrder}, #{dayNumber}, #{attractionName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{estimatedDurationMin}, #{trafficTimeFromPrev}, #{weatherNote}, #{llmDescription}, NOW())

INSERT INTO plan_steps (plan_id, step_order, day_number, attraction_name, latitude, longitude, estimated_duration_min, traffic_time_from_prev, weather_note, llm_description, created_at) VALUES
(#{s.planId}, #{s.stepOrder}, #{s.dayNumber}, #{s.attractionName}, #{s.latitude}, #{s.longitude}, #{s.estimatedDurationMin}, #{s.trafficTimeFromPrev}, #{s.weatherNote}, #{s.llmDescription}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM plan_steps WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY step_order ASC
